_comment: LOCKSTEP #19 (MTG_CANON_CONT_TRAITS; docs/design/rollout-executor-lockstep.md #19), the board of held-out
AccomplishedAlchemist s160426 gi425 at turn 5 main 1. The pre-fix search commits a VERIFIED T5 kill: Forest,
Seedcradle Witch, Living Wish -> Brindle Boar; the Witch's site-9 continuation is the Combo Off route (the Boar,
its sac for 4, the Witch loop pumps the Alchemist to 20 and leaves it untapped -- combat-lethal); then the Living
Wish's DEFERRED continuation, the unbranched canon [cast Arbor Elf, Seedcradle Witch: untap ...]. A canon applies
its casts only, but the rollout built its traits from the whole list, so the act-line hold kept a green provider
for the never-made activation and Arbor Elf's {G} came off Elvish Harbinger. The executor replays the line's
RECORDS (the canon's casts only): no hold, the payer taps the pumped Alchemist, only Harbinger attacks -- and the
spent board does not win T6 either ([fd-diverge] predicted 5, realised none; with MTG_CANON_CONT_TRAITS=0).
With the fix the rollout pays the canon exactly as the executor does, sees that kill fail, and plays its honest
T6 line, which the game realises. Asserts the realised T6. (A T5 kill does exist on this board -- the route with
the deferred continuation declined, or Arbor Elf paid by Harbinger -- but a plan targets ONE breakpoint, the
second is an unchallengeable canon and the payer's source is not searched; see the AA ledger, LOCKSTEP #19.)
